h1: A Megaflo air-gap problem keeps returning
title: A Megaflo air-gap problem keeps returning | G3 Cylinder Help
description: Understand a megaflo air-gap problem keeps returning. Distinguish the symptom, gather useful details and arrange competent cylinder assessment in London.
answer: Repeated discharge after air-gap attention needs the cause reviewed, rather than assuming that more frequent recharging is the complete solution.

sections.heading: What this symptom can mean
paragraphs: The correct internal expansion procedure applies only to relevant models. Continuing discharge can involve other pressure controls, valve condition or the installed arrangement. Larger or different cylinder ranges may instead use an external vessel.

sections.heading: Information to gather safely
paragraphs: Share who carried out the earlier work, whether discharge stopped and how quickly it returned. Do not keep operating relief devices on the strength of a generic video.

sections.heading: How the enquiry becomes an investigation
paragraphs: The cylinder make, full model and heating arrangement should be identified first. The same visible symptom can arise from different causes, and a relief device may be protecting the system rather than creating the original problem. Component testing and any repair belong to a person competent for the work.

sections.heading: Discuss the appropriate next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 with the postcode, symptom history and any previous service findings. The enquiry establishes the proposed assessment and availability. Do not use this guide as a substitute for the actual appliance safety instructions or an on-site diagnosis.

faqs.question: What if a Megaflo still discharges after the correct air-gap attention?
faqs.answer: Further assessment is needed. The manufacturer advises competent attention when discharge continues; other pressure or valve faults may be involved.
